title: Concrete Volume Methodology
overview: Concrete is ordered in cubic yards. Accurate volume calculation prevents costly over-ordering or project delays from under-ordering.

methods.name: Slab/Foundation Volume
methods.description: Volume equals length times width times depth, converted to cubic yards.

formula.name: Cubic Yards
formula.expression:
Volume (cu yd) = (L × W × D) / 27
Where L, W, D are in feet
27 cubic feet = 1 cubic yard

limitations: Irregular shapes need breaking into sections

footnotes: Standard slab: 4 inches thick, reinforced with wire mesh
Ready-mix concrete: ~$125-150 per cubic yard (varies by region)
